source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned cleanup removes the default calendar.threading.disabled preference and the cal.threadingEnabled lazy getter. The exact-name tracked-source search finds no other direct named callers before removal and no accepted occurrences, within Thunderbird/shared scope. The separate calendar.threading.latency preference remains an iterator-event soft limit; its stored name still has a trailing space. This is a narrow declaration cleanup, not evidence that a worker thread or scheduler changed behavior.
title: The removed Calendar threading toggle is separate from iterator latency
